pins.name: Abandoned Town
pins.description:
This is a town destroyed by time, yet it’s still being used by slave traders. Go left to head up the mountain, and right to reach the Rolling Stone Fortress.
Level 6

pins.name: Airport
pins.description:
Crystal-blue seawater engulfs the abandoned airport. Rust-eaten runways slant into the ocean depths, and cracked portholes are smothered in seaweed. Wreckage sways in the undercurrents, sand buries the boarding bridges, leaving only schools of fish darting through the ruins, silently whispering of its former bustle.
Level 4
Underwater, 95 m deep

pins.name: Amuzement Park
pins.description:
What was once a playground of laughter has sunk to the bottom of the sea, and a lot of electronic parts can now be found here.
Level 3
Underwater, 72 m deep

pins.name: Apartments
pins.description:
The once bustling residential neighborhoods are now submerged in a quiet seabed, with supplies in the ruins of buildings waiting for scavengers.
Level 3
Underwater, 53 m deep

pins.name: Big Bucket Fortress
pins.description:
One of the more wasteful ways of shooting a gun is called “splashing”, and this fort is called “The Big Bucket”.
Level 4

pins.name: Bridge Trading Post
pins.description:
The Bridge Shop specializes in all types of firearm parts, and the owner is very hospitable—provided you clear out the pirates who come to rob him.
Level 3

pins.name: Cape Lookout
pins.description:
Cape Lookout used to be huge, but after geological changes, there is now only such a small piece left.
Level 1

pins.name: District 43
pins.description:
Submerged neighborhoods with an abundance of necessities await scavengers.
Level 2
Underwater, 17 m deep

pins.name: Dreadville
pins.description:
This is one of Warheads’ lairs. However, with the rising sea levels, its importance has declined.
Level 5
Underwater, 3 m deep

pins.name: Eastmost Ranch
pins.description:
Sunken mini-farm with a few more supplies that can be gathered.
Level 1
Underwater, 5 m deep

pins.name: Floating Refuge
pins.description:
This place has long become a pirate den. Dozens of rusted iron ships are crudely welded together, stacked layer upon layer into a gloomy fortress. Sea wind sweeps across the ships' steel frames, letting out a terrifying clanging echo.
Level 3

pins.name: Green Isle
pins.description:
It got the name Green Island because there used to be a lot of trees here, but with the gradual rise in sea level, this place will probably have to be called an oasis from now on.
Level 3
Underwater, 5 m deep

pins.name: Halloween Island
pins.description:
A mysterious island shrouded in eerie fog, where creepy jack-o'-lanterns, abandoned graves, and unknown dangers lurk in the darkness. Dare to enter and uncover its Halloween secrets!
Level 4

pins.name: Kraken's Cove
pins.description:
A small group of mutants has gained a foothold here and is preparing to develop into a new tribe.
Level 2
Underwater, 5 m deep

pins.name: Loner Base
pins.description:
Don't look like a small place in this hellhole, but it's got a lot of firepower.
Level 4

pins.name: Machine Factory
pins.description:
Sunken factories on the bottom of the ocean with lots of parts to pick up.
Level 3
Underwater, 51 m deep

pins.name: Main road
pins.description:
This main highway connects the amusement park and the airport, telling of the city’s former glory.
Level 4
Underwater, 70 m deep

pins.name: Metal Mine
pins.description:
If you're short of ore, this is the right place to come.
Level 5
Underwater, 2 m deep

pins.name: Military Port
pins.description:
It's a heavily ranked steel fortress, and it's going to take a lot of effort to take it down.
Level 6

pins.name: Mutant Settlement
pins.description:
The old home of the mutants, the square altar under which the treasures the mutants scavenged from the neighborhood are buried.
Level 2

pins.name: Nameless Beach
pins.description:
A few mutants have taken over and are trying to turn it into a bridgehead.
Level 1

pins.name: Neptune
pins.description:
What goodies await the next guest to board a medium-sized freighter that sank here?
Level 3
Underwater, 73 m deep

pins.name: Pirate Hideout
pins.description:
A secret pirate stronghold where the boss collects tolls by virtue of a revolver.
Level 2

pins.name: Pirate Transport Ship
pins.description:
A mysterious pirate transport ship has been stranded at sea due to mechanical failure. Wonder what valuable loot is on board?
Level 5

pins.name: Police Station
pins.description:
If you're short on handy weapons, why not check this place out - as long as the sharks watching the door look at you favorably.
Level 3
Underwater, 47 m deep

pins.name: Power Plant
pins.description:
When you come here, you have to be careful about getting shot, but you also have to be careful about bringing a de-radiation potion.
Level 5
Underwater, 4 m deep

pins.name: Prison Island
pins.description:
The slavers centralized the unmanageable prickly slaves into one place.
Level 5

pins.name: Radio Island
pins.description:
In theory, radio telescopes are considered a type of antenna.
Level 4
Underwater, 7 m deep

pins.name: Reefside Camp
pins.description:
Refugees from the Sunken Lands have set up a camp here that barely fends off the pirates - though sometimes they are the pirates.
Level 2

pins.name: Refinery
pins.description:
This is a fully intact oil refinery. Plenty of fuel still remains in the pipelines buried beneath the sand.
Level 4
Underwater, 50 m deep

pins.name: Rolling Stone Fortress
pins.description:
As the logistics base of the military port, the Rolling Stone Fortress has hollowed out part of the mountain to serve as the stronghold, and also opened up a vegetable garden to grow fresh vegetables.
Level 6

pins.name: Shallowreef Town
pins.description:
The large camp they have set up here is ready to be used as a base camp.
Level 3

pins.name: ShipGraveyard
pins.description:
What on earth is the reason that has led to so many sunken ships here?
Level 5
Underwater, 13 m deep

pins.name: Skeleton Camp
pins.description:
Carry enough grenades! Or you'll get shot into a hornet's nest!
Level 5

pins.name: Small Rock Island
pins.description:
There is a lot of iron ore on Little Rock Island - small is relative here.
Level 3

pins.name: Stormborn Outpost
pins.description:
Feel the storm of bullets from Black Dynamite!
Level 2

pins.name: The Castaway Island
pins.description:
Abandoned by the Drifters, the island has been scavenged and has few resources left - the nearby waters do have some recoverable supplies.
Level 1

pins.name: The Cliffton Outpost
pins.description:
The slave traders use this place as a transit point and plan to establish trade routes connecting several outposts.
Level 4

pins.name: The Eden Isle
pins.description:
Slave traders have seized this peaceful island. All the aborigines of Oceania have been locked in iron cages as commodities, waiting to be sold at a price. Though it’s still called Eden Island, it is no longer a sanctuary in the apocalypse.
Level 4

pins.name: The Mansion
pins.description:
Once the private mansion of a wealthy man, I'm told he had a penchant for black powder weapons and a beautiful collection of muskets.
Level 2
Underwater, 34 m deep

pins.name: The Ruins Island
pins.description:
A small island occupied by slavers and generally used as a staging area.
Level 5

pins.name: Three Barrel Island
pins.description:
A few mutants have taken over the area, intending to flourish.
Level 1

pins.name: Trading Outpost
pins.description:
It's OK to take extra supplies here to be shared, but remember, there's no such thing as a crook - especially at POBC.
Level 2

pins.name: Two-Rock Beach
pins.description:
Using the unique terrain of the shallows, a few mutants have been up to no good.
Level 1

pins.name: Underground Fortress
pins.description:
This underground fortress is the last stronghold of the warhead. Their leader stays here, mapping out strategies and plotting their next moves from the shadows. Equipped with hidden underground artillery batteries and guarded by elite soldiers at every corner, it is impenetrable and stands as an unbreakable bastion for the warhead in their final stand.
Level 6

pins.name: Unknown Ruins
pins.description:
A place whose name has been forgotten is said to have treasure hidden in a well.
Level 2
Underwater, 19 m deep

pins.name: Warehouse
pins.description:
There's a lot of good stuff hidden inside the warehouse - as long as you can take out the guards that watch over the place.
Level 4

pins.name: Winding Mountain Fortress
pins.description:
Follow the fortress all the way to the end, and you’ll reach the shelter inside the mountain. But to get through this path, you’ll need enough bullets and supplies.
Level 6

pins.name: Zion Atoll
pins.description:
Now this city is full of guns and gunpowder and has nothing to do with God.
Level 4
